Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Children  [OR] and adolescents  [AND] who are diagnosed with pediatric chronic severe plaque psoriasis

right.raw_text: -  Prior to participating in the study, adalimumab treatment was determined according to clinical judgement of the physician

left.raw_text: -  Participants (or legal representative) who voluntarily agreed to participate in this study and signed informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Participants with contraindication to adalimumab as listed in the approved Korean label

right.raw_text: -  Participants with prior treatment with adalimumab
